title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Tourism and Cultural Preservation
prompt: In many countries, tourism has become a major source of income, but it can also lead to the commercialisation of local traditions and the erosion of cultural authenticity. Some people believe that tourism authorities should strictly limit visitor numbers to protect cultural heritage, while others argue that tourism brings economic and social benefits that outweigh these risks. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请针对题目要求，讨论双方观点并给出你自己的立场。建议先明确两种观点的核心论据，再结合具体例子（如过度旅游导致传统仪式表演化、社区收入增加等）展开论证。注意保持段落清晰，论点与论据对应，避免只描述现象而不作评价。
